column1: # PUBLIC tier: redistributable packs only (CC0, or CC-BY with the attribution recorded below).
# The audio itself is never committed: fetch-keysounds.sh downloads it on install.
# Your own additions go in packs-local.tsv (same columns, git-ignored).
# Columns (tab-separated): id  name  license  attribution  source page  download url  sha256  map
#   map = class:pattern;class:pattern  (class = key | space | enter | backspace; key is required)
#         zip url  -> pattern is a glob inside the unzipped archive
#         url/     -> pattern is a comma-separated list of files under that base url
#   sha256 = REQUIRED for every pack, checked before install (mismatch or missing = pack skipped):
#         zip url  -> sha256 of the archive
#         url/     -> sha256 of all listed files concatenated in map order
